messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing/metering anomaly detected (INC-2026-03-17-221). Emission gap observed on emitter-proxy cluster. Paging @oncall-rajan

oncall-rajan: ack, I'm awake. Triage starting now.

sre_tina: seeing proxy_emitter_zero spike across proxy-5 and proxy-6 starting 2026-03-17T08:42Z — counts drop to 0 for ~2-4m then large burst catch-up.

data-eng-lee: proxy-5 logs show repeated TLS handshake failures to collector-01 during the window. Snippet:
```
2026-03-17T08:42:12Z proxy-5 WARN tls: handshake timeout
2026-03-17T08:42:15Z proxy-5 ERROR write: broken pipe
2026-03-17T08:42:45Z proxy-5 INFO emitter_count=0
```

billing-qa: alerting tripped overage flags for 5 accounts. No billing job executed yet.

emily: which accounts and tiers? we should hold customer notifications until we confirm root cause and reconciliation plan.

billing-qa: acct_7777 (enterprise), acct_2222 (mid-market), acct_3333 (PLG), acct_4444 (enterprise), acct_5555 (trial). Marking acct_7777 & acct_4444 as high priority.

michelle: runbook step: engage fallback proxies (proxy-fallback-1) and mute outgoing overage emails. Command: `/billing mute overage --until 2026-03-17T10:00Z`.

oncall-rajan: routing traffic now for proxy-5 -> proxy-fallback-1: `/ops route-proxy --from proxy-5 --to proxy-fallback-1`.

incident-bot: Action recorded by oncall-rajan at 2026-03-17T08:50:02Z: routing change.

infra-jordan: starting backfill job: `backfill-usage --shard proxy-5 --start 2026-03-17T08:40Z --end 2026-03-17T08:48Z` ETA ~15m.

data-eng-lee: preliminary RCA: collector-01 had a short overload (GC spike) plus upstream NIC flaps; SDK behavior aggressively short-circuits on write errors resulting in emitter reporting zeros. Patch to relax short-circuit is ready.

sre_tina: applied temporary mitigation: increased TCP reconnect backoff and disabled short-circuit on write errors for proxy fleet. Monitoring.

billing-qa: paused overage-email job for incident: `/billing mute overage --by incident INC-2026-03-17-221`.

oncall-rajan: backfill at 40% and catching up. Noting a few accounts show duplicate tokens due to replay during catch-up; will kick off dedupe.

data-eng-lee: starting dedupe job: `dedupe-usage --window 2026-03-17T08:40Z-2026-03-17T08:55Z --shard proxy-5`.

emily: reaching out to acct_7777 owner with a short note: "We observed transient gaps and subsequent replay for a short window; no invoices charged yet. We'll follow up with reconciled usage and any adjustments." Posting draft to #customer-comms.

billing-qa: after backfill+dedupe we'll re-evaluate flags. Any enterprise accounts that still show overage will be put under manual verify before billing.

sre_tina: monitoring for 20m after backfill completes. If stable, we'll transition to postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident state: MITIGATED -> MONITORING at 2026-03-17T09:12:38Z. Mitigations: traffic rerouted, backfill started, dedupe in progress, overage emails muted.

infra-jordan: backfill complete. dedupe job finished; removed 12 duplicate events in the window. Net effect: tiny token inflation for a couple accounts (~0.02-0.05%), except acct_7777 requires manual review.

billing-qa: acct_7777 flagged for manual reconciliation. Holding any charge until confirmed. Opening billing ticket.

oncall-rajan: handing off to night oncall @oncall-maya. Handoff notes posted to #oncall-handoffs.

michelle: opening postmortem ticket INC-2026-03-17-221-PM assigned to data-eng-lee and sre_tina. Action items: harden SDK for TLS flaps, remove aggressive emitter short-circuit, adjust alert thresholds for emitter zeros, and add integration tests for backfill/dedupe correctness.

emily: summary for postmortem: transient emitter silence due to upstream collector instability -> replay produced duplicates for a small set of accounts; no automated charges applied; enterprise accounts proactively contacted and one account under manual reconciliation.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident updated at 2026-03-17T09:25:00Z. End of thread.
